items.title: US Fed likely to hold rates in October, hike by 25 bps by year
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve is expected to keep interest rates unchanged in October before resuming monetary tightening, with markets pricing in a further 25 basis points (bps) hike by the end of 2026 and cumulative tightening of 75 bps by mid-2027, according to a commentary by CareEdge Global.
